name: a glowing ship mark surfaces on a dark sea
looks: On a near-black field with a faint horizon line and thin glowing wave lines, a small ship mark fades up in silhouette, its glow seeding outward, with the bold wordmark settling above it a beat later.
build: noise-dissolve-logomark for the mark's materialising (seeded points condensing into the silhouette), then wordmark-assemble's settle stage for the name arriving above it; the wave lines are thin animated SVG paths with a slow horizontal drift.
sound: A low ambient swell, a soft glow-in shimmer as the mark resolves.
prompt: On a dark, near-empty field with a faint horizon and thin glowing lines suggesting water or motion, let a brand mark condense into its silhouette from scattered glow, then settle the bold wordmark above it a beat later. Keep the palette to one accent colour against near-black for a confident, moody brand moment.
